about.title: Two markets. One team.
paragraphs: Vikub Group is an international consulting and business development hub specialising in helping Italian companies enter the markets of Belarus and the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU).

We are the official representatives of the National Agency of Investment and Privatization of the Republic of Belarus (NAIP) in Italy. This gives us direct access to government support tools, up-to-date analysis and Belarusian businesses.

Our team combines Italian and Belarusian expertise: Mario Ubaldi is a business consultant with 20 years of experience working with Italian manufacturers; Viktoria Gubanova, former director of Planix Group, specialises in international business connections.
We offer end-to-end support, from market research to signing contracts and entering retail chains. We work with companies in different sectors according to their needs.
